examples.label: Install command with a copy button
examples.source:
Add Chelekom to your project
mix igniter.install mishka_chelekom <.component component_name="chelekom-clipboard" site="Global" id="clipboard-install" target_selector="#clipboard-install-snippet" show_status_text={false} dynamic_label={true} copy_success_text="Copied" class="shrink-0" > <:trigger> <.component component_name="chelekom-button" site="Global" size="extra_small" icon="hero-clipboard-document">Copy
